No.245/C.F/48.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA.
CABINET SECRETARIAT.
New Delhi, the 6th December, 1948.

#/texts/2.label: paragraph
#/texts/2.full_gt_text: The undersigned is directed to circulate for the information of all Ministries of the Government of India a copy of the minutes recorded by the Prime Minister relating to -

#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
(1) The appointment of Shri R.R.Diwakar, Member of the Constituent Assembly, as Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting with effect from the 7th December, 1948.
(2) The appointment of Dr.Balkrishnan V.Keskar, Member of the Constituent Assembly, as Deputy Minister with effect from the 7th December, 1948. He will be attached to the Ministry of External Affairs & Commonwealth Relations.

#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text:
(E.C.Donoghue)
for Joint Secretary to the Cabinet.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text:
All Secretaries to the Government of India.
-----

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: Copy with a copy of the enclosures forwarded to the Secretary and Military Secretary to the Governor-General/the Principal Private Secretary to the Prime Minister, for information.
